name: Sort-last Grid Construction
definition: A sort-last algorithm where for each primitive, the grid cells containing the primitive or a portion of it are determined. It uses an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) test for speed in interactive environments.
summary: Sort-last Grid Construction is a voxelization method that assigns primitives to grid cells by iterating over primitives, distinguishing it from sort-first by processing primitives to find cells rather than cells to find primitives.
